title: Paper-Quilled Haute Couture Gown Fashion Shot
prompt: Generate a full-body high-fashion shot of a ${subject:tall model with a sleek low bun} in a ${pose:elegant three-quarter standing pose}, wearing an avant-garde paper-quilled haute couture gown made of fluid, overlapping 3D ribbon strands. The dress features ${dress_features:a fitted corset bodice and sweeping train} made of swooping ribbon layers in a gradient of ${color_palette:vivid cobalt, emerald green, and gold}. Accessories include a ${headwear:wide-brimmed matching hat with quilled plume details}. Set against a ${background_color:dark charcoal grey} background with dramatic studio spotlighting highlighting texture and fine edges. Rendered in crisp, high-contrast 3D detail.
